tree_role: sample MCC with original sampled heights, not posterior median heights
probability_role: AIC-weighted marginal ancestral range probabilities on a fixed tree; not joint Bayesian posterior probabilities
age_intervals: 95% HPD of MRCA ages from both complete late Walbeck chains; show only passing node-age diagnostics; see node_age_interval_provenance.json

display_tree.role: same posterior sample, pruned display only; no outgroup range inference
display_tree.root_role: MRCA of sampled Lardizabalaceae and Circaeasteraceae; distinct from ingroup crown N01

node_age_labels.scope: all displayed internal nodes, including outgroup nodes
node_age_labels.source: original node heights of the displayed representative tree; not posterior median ages
